## Question

How does maximum-duration resident Delta AUC vary with destination temperature,
destination precipitation, and warming under the anchored random structure?

## Dataset and sample size

The validated Step 08 universe contains 1,604 effects, 526 species, and 42 experiments.

## Exact model specification

Fixed effects are `T_z * P_z * W_z`. Random effects are an independent species intercept, an independent species `W_z` slope, and a correlated species `T_z`/`P_z`/`TP_z` block (`GEN`).

## Assumptions

Effect estimates use the full ordered `V_auc`; CR1 clusters by experiment. Scaling is fixed before fitting.

## Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Optimizer codes, warnings, random covariance diagnostics, and all five profile-likelihood intervals are shown below.

## Main numerical results

```{r}
bundle <- targets::tar_read(mboth_526_refit_bundle)
refit <- targets::tar_read(mboth_526_refit_equivalence)
profiles <- targets::tar_read(mboth_variance_profile_equivalence)
knitr::kable(bundle$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(bundle$fixed)
knitr::kable(bundle$CR1)
knitr::kable(bundle$random)
knitr::kable(bundle$variance_profiles)
knitr::kable(refit)
knitr::kable(profiles)
```

## Interpretation boundary

CR1 is clustered by experiment. The model and all five profile-likelihood
variance intervals are fitted by analytical targets; the report only reads
their returned objects and numerical-equivalence gates.

## Canonical objects

`mboth_526_refit`, `mboth_526_refit_bundle`, and `mboth_variance_profiles_526`.

## PASS/FAIL

Both the direct fitted-object comparison and all five variance-profile comparisons must pass.
